endorsements.name: Andrés Elizalde Galdeano
endorsements.label: CVE-2023-6097
endorsements.description: A SQL injection vulnerability has been found in ICS Business Manager, affecting version 7.06.0028.7089. This vulnerability could allow a remote user to send a specially crafted SQL query and retrieve all the information stored in the database. The data could also be modified or deleted, causing the application to malfunction.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: CRITICAL (CVSS 3.1, 9.4)
